description: Central runtime configuration registry for the Stats application. This file names the configuration surfaces that must be supplied by committed safe defaults, ignored local overrides, environment variables, or managed secret providers instead of being hardcoded in source.

STATS_APP_ROOT.purpose: Physical runtime root for the current environment.

STATS_PATHS_CONFIG.purpose: Path to the central logical path map.

STATS_RUNTIME_CONFIG.purpose: Path to the central runtime configuration registry.

STATS_LOGGING_CONFIG.purpose: Path to the central logging configuration registry.

logging.note: The central logging registry is the source of truth for logging variable defaults and allowed values. This section keeps logging environment keys discoverable in the overall runtime registry.

LOG_REDACT_SENSITIVE_VALUES.purpose: Redact known sensitive values before writing logs.

STATS_STORAGE_PROVIDER.purpose: Storage provider selector for durable files and future cloud storage.
STATS_STORAGE_PROVIDER.default: AzureBlobStorage in cloud/container, LocalFileSystem for isolated local tests

STORAGE_ROOT.purpose: Local filesystem root for accepted intake files when LocalFileSystem storage is active.

STATS_VALIDATION_HANDOFF_DIR.purpose: Temporary M9 handoff directory for Data Validation DataValidationResult JSON files awaiting Azure SQL persistence.

DOCUMENT_REFERENCE_ROOTS.purpose: Allowed source roots for document parsing references.
DOCUMENT_REFERENCE_ROOTS.note: Resolve from configured Stats storage roots or explicit module environment overrides. Do not parse this note as a filesystem path.

DATABASE_PROVIDER.purpose: Database provider selector for persistence code. Active local/container/cloud runtime target is AzureSql.

DATABASE_SCHEMA.purpose: Default relational database schema for M9-owned Stats data tables.

AZURE_SQL_CONNECTIONSTRING.purpose: Azure SQL Database connection configuration for the cloud operational Stats store. Prefer Microsoft Entra or managed identity authentication; treat as secret when credentials are present.

DEFAULT_ADMIN_EMAIL.purpose: Optional bootstrap administrator email for local/container setup.

STATS_INTERNAL_API_KEY.purpose: Shared server-side secret used by Stats Web and M5/M7 modules when calling Stats Data recognition settings and admin endpoints. Stats Data requires this value via the X-Stats-Internal-Key header on /api/v1/admin/recognition-settings/* routes and fails closed when it is unset.

ALLOW_OCR_FALLBACK.purpose: Enables OCR fallback path when Tesseract is available.
ALLOW_OCR_FALLBACK.default: false locally, true in stats-runtime container

TESSERACT_CMD.purpose: Path to the Tesseract executable for the current runtime.

TESSDATA_PREFIX.purpose: Path to Tesseract language data for the current runtime.

OCR_PDF_FAST_PSM_VALUES.purpose: Small first-pass Tesseract page-segmentation mode set for scanned PDF pages before heavier repair attempts.

OCR_FAST_MIN_QUALITY_SCORE.purpose: Minimum OCR quality score that allows a scanned PDF page to skip heavier OCR repair.

OCR_FAST_MIN_TEXT_LENGTH.purpose: Minimum first-pass OCR text length that allows a scanned PDF page to skip heavier OCR repair.

OCR_PDF_RENDER_SCALE.purpose: PDF page render scale used before Tesseract OCR.

STATS_WEB_PORT.purpose: Stats Web container bind port for local/container runtime.

STATS_WEB_HOST_PORT.purpose: External Stats Web host port mapped by Docker Compose.

CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.purpose: Allowed browser origins for module APIs.

HEALTH_TIMEOUT.purpose: Service startup health wait timeout in seconds.

DB_HOST.purpose: Reserved non-Azure database host override for diagnostics only; active runtime uses Azure SQL connection configuration.

DB_PORT.purpose: Reserved non-Azure database port override for diagnostics only; active runtime uses Azure SQL connection configuration.

FILE_VALIDATION_PORT.purpose: File Validation and Ingestion API container-local port.

STATS_DATA_PORT.purpose: Stats Data persistence API container-local port.

DEBUG.purpose: Debug behavior switch for local development only.

DATABASE_ECHO.purpose: Database SQL echo switch for diagnostics.

MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES.purpose: Maximum file size accepted for validation.

REQUIRE_KNOWN_SIGNATURE.purpose: Whether file signatures must be recognized.

SUPPORTED_MIME_TYPES.purpose: MIME types supported by document parsing.

MAX_DOCUMENT_SIZE_BYTES.purpose: Maximum document size accepted by parsing.

ALLOW_DIRECT_TEXT.purpose: Whether direct PDF text extraction is allowed.

OCR_PDF_FAST_PSM_VALUES.purpose: Smaller first-pass Tesseract PSM set for scanned PDF pages.

OCR_FAST_MIN_QUALITY_SCORE.purpose: Minimum scanned-PDF fast-pass OCR quality before repair is skipped.

OCR_FAST_MIN_TEXT_LENGTH.purpose: Minimum scanned-PDF fast-pass OCR text length before repair is skipped.

OCR_PDF_RENDER_SCALE.purpose: PDF page render scale for OCR.

CLASSIFICATION_AI_ENABLED.purpose: Enables M5 AI-assisted document classification fallback after deterministic rules produce unknown, ambiguous, or low-confidence results.

CLASSIFICATION_AI_PROVIDER.purpose: AI classification provider selector. Supported values are gemini, openai, and openai_compatible.

CLASSIFICATION_AI_ENDPOINT.purpose: Optional AI classification endpoint override. Gemini defaults to Google generateContent for the configured model when this is empty.

CLASSIFICATION_AI_API_KEY_ENV.purpose: Name of the environment variable that contains the AI provider API key. The referenced value is secret and must come from a secret provider.

CLASSIFICATION_AI_MODEL.purpose: Model name used by optional M5 AI-assisted document classification.

CLASSIFICATION_AI_MODEL_VERSION.purpose: Model version or deployment label returned in M5 classification audit metadata.

CLASSIFICATION_AI_MIN_CONFIDENCE.purpose: Minimum AI confidence required before M5 accepts an AI-assisted document classification.

CLASSIFICATION_AI_TRIGGER_THRESHOLD.purpose: Rule-confidence threshold below which M5 may ask the optional AI classifier for help.

CLASSIFICATION_AI_MAX_CHARS.purpose: Maximum redacted extracted-text characters sent to the optional AI classifier.

TRANSACTION_CLASSIFICATION_AI_ENABLED.purpose: Enables M7 optional AI-assisted fallback for weak, ambiguous, or unknown transaction and spending category classification.

TRANSACTION_CLASSIFICATION_AI_PROVIDER.purpose: M7 AI classification provider selector. Supported values are gemini, openai, and openai_compatible.

TRANSACTION_CLASSIFICATION_AI_ENDPOINT.purpose: Optional M7 AI classification endpoint override. Gemini defaults to Google generateContent and OpenAI defaults to chat completions for the configured model when this is empty.

TRANSACTION_CLASSIFICATION_AI_API_KEY_EN.purpose: Name of the environment variable containing the M7 AI provider API key. The referenced value is secret and must come from a secret provider.

TRANSACTION_CLASSIFICATION_AI_MODEL.purpose: Model name used by optional M7 AI-assisted transaction classification.

TRANSACTION_CLASSIFICATION_AI_MODEL_VERS.purpose: Model version or deployment label returned in M7 transaction classification audit metadata.

TRANSACTION_CLASSIFICATION_AI_MIN_CONFID.purpose: Minimum AI confidence required before M7 accepts AI-assisted transaction/category classification.

TRANSACTION_CLASSIFICATION_AI_TRIGGER_TH.purpose: Rule-confidence threshold below which M7 may ask the optional AI classifier for help.

TRANSACTION_CLASSIFICATION_AI_MAX_CHARS.purpose: Maximum redacted transaction-context characters sent to the optional M7 AI classifier.

MERCHANT_CLASSIFICATION_LOOKUP_URL.purpose: Internal M9 endpoint M7 calls to reuse exact human-confirmed merchant classifications before AI-assisted classification.

ALLOW_DOCUMENT_REFERENCES.purpose: Whether parsing can read configured document references.

DEFAULT_CURRENCY.purpose: Default currency for extraction and validation.

MAX_TEXT_CHARS.purpose: Maximum text characters processed by extraction.

EMAIL_PROVIDER.purpose: Email provider adapter selector for M12. Initial safe default is synthetic.

EMAIL_INGESTION_MODE.purpose: Email ingestion runtime mode such as dry_run or handoff.

FILE_INGESTION_BASE_URL.purpose: M3/M4 file ingestion API target used by M12 accepted attachment handoff.

DOCUMENT_PARSING_BASE_URL.purpose: M5 parse API target used by the M12 database-ingest path (process-imported / scheduled ingest).

TRANSACTION_EXTRACTION_BASE_URL.purpose: M7 extraction API target used by the M12 database-ingest path.

DATA_VALIDATION_BASE_URL.purpose: M8 validation API target used by the M12 database-ingest path.

STATS_DATA_BASE_URL.purpose: M9 Stats Data API target (processing jobs, recognition context, transaction save) used by the M12 database-ingest path.

EMAIL_SOURCE_CONFIG_STORE.purpose: M12 source profile store selector such as memory for tests or azure_sql for cloud runtime.

EMAIL_SECRET_PROVIDER.purpose: M12 secret provider selector such as environment, memory, azure_sql, container_apps_secret, or azure_key_vault.

EMAIL_KEY_VAULT_URL.purpose: Azure Key Vault URL used when M12 EMAIL_SECRET_PROVIDER is azure_key_vault.

EMAIL_SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY.purpose: Encryption key material used when M12 stores mailbox/PDF secret values in the central runtime store. Prefer a dedicated managed secret; falls back to ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET_KEY only for local compatibility.

ALLOWED_ATTACHMENT_EXTENSIONS.purpose: Comma-separated M12 attachment filename extension allowlist.

ALLOWED_ATTACHMENT_MIME_TYPES.purpose: Comma-separated M12 attachment MIME type allowlist.

MAX_ATTACHMENT_SIZE_BYTES.purpose: Maximum attachment size M12 will consider before handoff.

DEFAULT_LOOKBACK_HOURS.purpose: Default M12 retrieval lookback window hint.

DEFAULT_MAX_MESSAGES.purpose: Default M12 IMAP message count per run. Use 0 in run requests for no message limit.

IMAP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.purpose: Socket timeout for M12 IMAP connections and mailbox actions.

HANDOFF_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.purpose: Timeout for M12 attachment handoff uploads to file intake.

POLLING_ENABLED.purpose: Enables future M12 scheduled polling runtime behavior.

REDACT_EMAIL_SUBJECTS.purpose: Redacts email subject metadata in M12 output and evidence by default.

PDF_PASSWORD_SECRET_PREFIX.purpose: Prefix for reusable source-level PDF password secrets referenced by M12/M5 password handling.

BLOCK_PRIVATE_IMAP_HOSTS.purpose: Blocks M12 IMAP hosts that resolve to private, loopback, link-local, or reserved address ranges unless explicitly allowlisted by code policy.

ALLOWED_IMAP_HOSTS.purpose: Optional comma-separated allowlist of M12 IMAP hostnames for cloud evidence or provider pinning.

AUTOMATED_PIPELINE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.purpose: HTTP timeout for each M12 process-imported parse/extract/validate/save downstream call.

AUTOMATED_UPLOADED_BY_USER_ID.purpose: System provenance id used when M12 creates automated processing jobs.

AUTOMATED_SAVED_BY_USER_ID.purpose: System provenance id used when M12 saves automated email-ingested transaction batches.

AUTOMATED_ALLOW_OCR_FALLBACK.purpose: Whether M12 automated process-imported parsing requests allow OCR fallback.

AUTOMATED_CLASSIFICATION_THRESHOLD.purpose: Classification threshold sent by M12 automated process-imported parsing requests.

statsWebDownstream.StatsApi__BaseUrl: Browser-facing Identity API base URL or same-origin proxy base.
statsWebDownstream.StatsWeb__Downstream__FileValidationBase: Browser-facing File Validation base URL or same-origin proxy base.
statsWebDownstream.StatsWeb__Downstream__FileIngestionBaseU: Browser-facing File Ingestion base URL or same-origin proxy base.
statsWebDownstream.StatsWeb__Downstream__DocumentParsingBas: Browser-facing Document Parsing base URL or same-origin proxy base.
statsWebDownstream.StatsWeb__Downstream__TransactionExtract: Browser-facing Transaction Extraction base URL or same-origin proxy base.
statsWebDownstream.StatsWeb__Downstream__DataValidationBase: Browser-facing Data Validation base URL or same-origin proxy base.
statsWebDownstream.StatsWeb__Downstream__EmailIngestionBase: Browser-facing Email Ingestion base URL or same-origin proxy base.
statsWebDownstream.StatsWeb__Proxy__IdentityBaseUrl: Server-side proxy target for Identity Access.
statsWebDownstream.StatsWeb__Proxy__FileValidationBaseUrl: Server-side proxy target for File Validation.
statsWebDownstream.StatsWeb__Proxy__FileIngestionBaseUrl: Server-side proxy target for File Ingestion.
statsWebDownstream.StatsWeb__Proxy__DocumentParsingBaseUrl: Server-side proxy target for Document Parsing.
statsWebDownstream.StatsWeb__Proxy__TransactionExtractionBa: Server-side proxy target for Transaction Extraction.
statsWebDownstream.StatsWeb__Proxy__DataValidationBaseUrl: Server-side proxy target for Data Validation.
statsWebDownstream.StatsWeb__Proxy__StatsDataBaseUrl: Server-side proxy target for Stats Data persistence.
statsWebDownstream.StatsWeb__Proxy__EmailIngestionBaseUrl: Server-side proxy target for Email Ingestion.

STATS_TESTDATA_DIR.purpose: Configured real-data fixture directory for module and evidence tests.
STATS_TESTDATA_DIR.privacyNote: May point to local private files; do not commit real source files.

STATS_PARSING_TESTDATA_DIR.privacyNote: May point to local private files; do not commit real source files.

STATS_EDGE_EXECUTABLE.purpose: Optional browser executable override for screenshot evidence.

STATS_ENVIRONMENT.purpose: Cloud runtime environment label such as cloud-dev, test, or prod.

AZURE_CONTAINER_APP_NAME.purpose: Azure Container Apps resource name for the Stats runtime.

AZURE_CONTAINER_APP_ENVIRONMENT.purpose: Azure Container Apps managed environment name.

AZURE_CONTAINER_REGISTRY.purpose: Azure Container Registry hostname that stores the Stats runtime image.

AZURE_KEY_VAULT_URI.purpose: Key Vault URI used for managed secret references.

AZURE_MANAGED_IDENTITY_CLIENT_ID.purpose: User-assigned managed identity client ID when a cloud runtime needs an explicit identity reference.

AZURE_SQL_SERVER.purpose: Azure SQL logical server name or host for the cloud operational Stats database.

AZURE_SQL_DATABASE.purpose: Azure SQL database name for the cloud operational Stats database.

AZURE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT_NAME.purpose: Storage account name used when STATS_STORAGE_PROVIDER=AzureBlobStorage.

AZURE_STORAGE_CONTAINER_NAME.purpose: Blob container name used for durable document storage when AzureBlobStorage is enabled.

AZURE_STORAGE_BLOB_PREFIX.purpose: Blob path prefix for accepted intake files.

AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING.purpose: Temporary storage connection string if managed identity storage access is not yet implemented.

STATS_AS_OF_DATE.purpose: Optional reporting clock override in yyyy-MM-dd format. When set, Stats treats this as the current reporting date for dashboard and analytics periods without changing the machine clock.

STATS_REPORTING_DEFAULT_CURRENCY.purpose: Default reporting currency selected in Stats Web before a user changes the currency toggle. Keep NZD as the committed product default for the current New Zealand user context.

STATS_REPORTING_FX_RATES.purpose: Optional comma-separated reporting FX override pairs, such as PHP:NZD=0.0300,NZD:AUD=0.9200,NZD:USD=0.6100, for historical or local testing until an auditable FX reference table is available. Cross-currency rates may be derived from configured bridge pairs.

FABRIC_WORKSPACE_ID.purpose: Microsoft Fabric workspace identifier used for curated analytics data and evidence.

FABRIC_LAKEHOUSE_ID.purpose: Fabric lakehouse or warehouse identifier used for curated Stats reporting data.

POWERBI_WORKSPACE_ID.purpose: Power BI workspace identifier for Stats reports.

POWERBI_REPORT_ID.purpose: Power BI report identifier for Stats dashboard/report embedding.

POWERBI_TENANT_ID.purpose: Microsoft Entra tenant identifier used for Power BI embedding or service principal authentication.

POWERBI_CLIENT_ID.purpose: Service principal client ID for app-owned Power BI embedding when required.

POWERBI_CLIENT_SECRET.purpose: Service principal secret for Power BI embedding when certificate or managed identity auth is not yet available.

rule: If a value changes by developer machine, container, cloud environment, secret rotation, deployment target, port conflict, or test fixture location, it belongs in configuration and not as an application-code literal.
